title: E/10734/2018 — Bhavani Industries vs. Rajkot
text:
In The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
West Zonal Bench At Ahmedabad
E/COD/10301/10302/2018-SM
Appeal No.E/10733/10734/2018-SM
M/s Bhavani Industries Appellant
Vs
C.C.E. & S.T.-Rajkot Respondent
Represented by:
For Appellant: Shri Rahul Gajera (Advocate)
For Respondent: Shri Gobind Jha(AR)
CORAM:
HON’BLE DR. D.M. MISRA, MEMBER (JUDICIAL)
Date of Hearing/Decision: 24.04.2018
Misc. Order No. _M/ 10337-10338___/2018
Per: D. M. Misra
Heard both the sides.
2. This application is filed seeking condonation of delay of 31 days
in filing the appeal before this forum.
3. In view of the reasons explained in COD application, the delay is
condoned. MA(COD) is allowed.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open court)
(Dr. D.M. Misra)
Member (Judicial)
seema
